The Story

20 Years Behind The Camera.
One Thing Kept Bothering Me.

I am Chad Pennington, a commercial photographer and creative strategist. For 20 years I have helped businesses tell their story. And I kept running into the same thing.

Great businesses. Real customers who loved them. And no website.

So when somebody heard their name and went looking, there was nothing to find. No number to tap. No menu. No booking. No way to buy. The story was there. Nobody could stop and hear it.

So I sat down and built 17 of them in 7 days to prove how fast a good business can stop being invisible.

Before You Ask

The Five Objections, Answered

“What does it actually cost?”

It is right on this page with no games. The full list is a $3,750 value. Way One is $500 and we keep it running for you. Maintenance is $49 if you pay the $500 in one payment and $100 if you pay in payments. Way Two is $1,000 and the site is yours outright with no maintenance fee and nothing ongoing. That is every dollar. There is no surprise charge later.

“I already have Facebook.”

Facebook is rented ground. It decides who sees you and it buries your number under menus. When somebody searches your name on Google, a Facebook page is not what they hope to find. Your website is the one place online you actually own and it puts calling, booking, and ordering one tap away.

“I do not have good photos.”

That is the easiest part. You are hiring a commercial photographer. Real photos of your business, your work, and your people are part of the build. You do not have to figure that out first.

“One day? Really?”

Really, when the pieces are ready. Each build gets my full focus for a full day, which is why I only open 3 build slots a week. That is exactly why the three questions above matter. Ready businesses get the day. Everybody else gets honest advice.

“What happens after it is built?”

That is what the two ways are for. With Way One at $500 we keep it running for you. Maintenance is $49 if you paid in full or $100 if you paid in payments and you never think about it again. With Way Two at $1,000 the site is yours outright with no maintenance fee and nothing ongoing. Either way you approve it before it goes live. And if you do not love it, you do not pay for a site you are not proud of.
